history.sg_progress: UNSMIL indicates that the revised service catalogue is intended to establish reasonable rate cards in collaboration with the master data management team at the Office of Programme Planning, Finance and Budget. UNSMIL will obtain the necessary approvals and create an efficient cost plan. The plan is designed to enhance revenue utilization and address the existing nonexpendable surplus resulting from noncompliance with the cost-recovery policy. The Mission aims to achieve compliance with the 2023 cost-recovery policy by the first quarter of 2025, pending approval of its cost plan by the Controller. The Office of Programme Planning, Finance and Budget is committed to collaborating with UNSMIL on its cost-recovery initiatives.

history.administration_response: The Office of Programme Planning, Finance and Budget continues to work with UNSMIL staff to review their cost- recovery activities and rates. UNSMIL continues to diligently engage with the Office on the review and approval of its revised service catalogue, which is in its final stage. The 2025 cost plan developed by UNSMIL was successfully submitted in December 2024 and was approved by the necessary parties in February 2025. The target completion date is 30 June 2025.
history.board_assessment: Given that the review of cost recovery activities and rates remains under way, the Board considers the recommendation to be under implementation.
